## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour.

## Related issue

Closes #<issue-number>

## Validation

State what was run and the results. For documentation-only changes, describe the review performed. Include screenshots for interface changes.

## Limitations

Record material assumptions, unresolved concerns, or follow-up work.

## Review

- [ ] Acceptance checks are satisfied.
- [ ] The diff contains only intended changes.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials or excluded data/artifacts are included.
